links.reported_relation: Constructor pre-sets totalSupply = 1 000 000 with zero underlying assets and totalAssets evaluates to 1 at first fulfilment, so shares minted against that near-zero denominator diverge from assetsToFulfill.
Math.mulDiv with the 1-wei denominator inflates/devalues shares, letting the first depositor control ~100% of shares for negligible cost.
